description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open source project and handles importing requirements from various file formats (CSV, XML, Doors CSV, DocBook). It includes functions for initializing parameters, processing file uploads, importing data from XML or other formats, and setting up the user interface. The code contains core logic for importing requirements into the system, including validation, file handling, and interaction with requirement management classes.

methods.name: doExecuteImport
methods.description: Handles the import process, including file upload management and dispatching to XML or alternative import functions based on import type.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves argument parameters from the request and session, setting defaults where necessary.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object used by Smarty templates, including configuration of import types, paths, and options.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies user permissions to access requirement management functionalities.

methods.name: doReqImportFromXML
methods.description: Parses XML requirement specifications and creates requirements or requirement specifications accordingly.

methods.name: doReqImportOther
methods.description: Imports requirements from non-XML files, processing data loaded from external sources.
